delivered.statement: FY'26 YoY growth 9.4% rupees, 3% USD; constant currency Q3 growth 1.5%
Organic growth negative under 1% for quarter; impacted by project timing shifts
EBITDA growth 6.8% post-absorbing partial increments this quarter
Fixed price revenue 66% vs 59% prior year; higher quality revenue mix achieved
TCV of deals won during quarter: INR 202 million across geographies
Solutions business investment USD 3.8 million this quarter; excludes AI investments
Cash at quarter end INR 9 billion post INR 6.3 billion acquisition payouts
New Labour Code one-time post-tax impact INR 469 million; ongoing impact ongoing
Net profit excluding Labour Code impact 1.53 billion, flat vs prior quarter

themes: Solutions-based business transformation away from pure services model
AI integration in production programs; Microsoft partnership as frontier tech partner
Market consolidation gaining wallet share from local on-site vendors in Europe
OEM budgets down 20-25% passenger cars; prioritizing digital cockpit, cyber security, navigation autopilot
Off-highway commercial and micro-mobility growth via Caresoft and Hero partnerships
Leadership expansion for solutions execution capability across AI, domains, sales
risks: Geopolitical tariffs and US policy uncertainty reducing OEM spending, especially Japan exposure
Large program maturation (Honda) impacting Japan revenue; JPY fell from ~40M to 30M quarterly
Solutions adoption execution risk; broad-based OEM adoption success still unproven at scale
Legacy OEM competitiveness threat from Tesla and Chinese EV makers gaining market share
analyst_pushback: Cannibalization concern - Karan Uppal; management said solutions end up capturing bigger wallet share than cannibalized portion
Market share vs pie shrinkage - Vidyadhar Ginde; management said pie shrunk 20-25%, but gained wallet share with T25 clients
Muted TCV pipeline - Karan Uppal; management said Q4 will be highest quarterly growth, don't read much into Q3
Solutions adoption risk - Ankur Pant; management said solutions already piloted, not choice but necessity for OEMs stuck in programs
AI solution success probability - Bhavik Mehta; management said solutions vetted and piloted, taking full ownership unlike past attempts
tone_evidence: Cautious on Q3 organic growth, defensive on near-term headwinds, confident on strategic solutions pivot and medium-term growth
